about: Post hoc single-case Slack H3 diagnostic after the workspace-inclusive v1-v3 stages stopped on ARGUS's large-context Warrant workload. Select the pre-existing GT-validated dev Slack pair by fixed case ID from the unchanged H3 cases/plan. This is not the original multi-case H3 hypothesis test; no v1-v3 row is pooled.
authorization_basis: The user directed execution after a concrete plan without another confirmation. V1-v3 actual guard cost is $0.46521870. Slack S1 and conditional S2 maxima are $0.20 and $0.50, so cumulative actual-plus-maximum is $1.16521870, below the previously presented $3.25 total.

case_plan.selection_reason: The existing Slack page response is 63 characters and one ARGUS context span in deterministic GT; this case was registered dev before v1-v3 paid outcomes. Selection is post hoc by known workload, so results are diagnostic.

defaults.fidelity: backbone-substituted: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash for AgentDojo agent and ARGUS Warrant judges

H3-SLACK-S1.description: Four fresh Slack-only diagnostic rows: TOOL_L/PROMPT_L x none/Warrant x one repeat. Gate the full panel on completion, native utility, L opportunity, identity and cost projection.

estimate.anchor: Slack deterministic GT has 39 tool-description spans and one short webpage-result span; model behavior unverified

H3-SLACK-S1.compares_to: Same Slack task, native utility, L and sink; only trusted prompt placement differs.

H3-SLACK-S2.description: Twenty fresh Slack-only rows: TOOL_L/PROMPT_L x none/Warrant x five repeats. S1 rows are diagnostic and not pooled. Run only if S1 gates and 1.2 x 5 cost/workload projection pass.

estimate.anchor: Launch only if 1.2 times five times S1 actual USD/tokens/requests fit these caps

H3-SLACK-S2.compares_to: Single-case post hoc descriptive Warrant false-block difference; never pooled with workspace or confirmatory H3.
